notes.title: Deathless Speedrun - World Record
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Remember [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/purpleninjagirl/]PurpleNinjaGirl[/url], whose speedrun we featured in an announcement some time ago? 
Well, guess what? She's done it again, but this time she's achieved what we thought was impossible—she completed the game without losing a single life, and she did it in just 10 minutes and 15 seconds. 
That's right, no deaths, record time—see it with your own eyes in the video below!

Eva is convinced this isn't the end, though, and that we'll witness even more impressive records in the future [i](and it's wise to take Eva's word for it)[/i]. Don’t forget you can view all past, present, and future speedruns, and even participate by sharing your own feats on our [url=https://www.speedrun.com/We_are_Eva]Speedrun website page[/url].
[previewyoutube=7A-jcXPLj28;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Eva is in the Top-100! Round 2
notes.notes:
Eva is sleeping happily today! Do you know why? ([i]Pretend you haven't seen the headline[/i]) 
Because [i]"We are Eva"[/i] made it to the [url=https://www.indiedb.com/groups/2023-indie-of-the-year-awards/top100#vote80583]Top 100 Indies of the Year[/url] on IndieDB! We did it! 

And while we were trying to figure out how this even happened, IndieDB has started the [url=https://www.indiedb.com/groups/2023-indie-of-the-year-awards/top100#vote80583]second round[/url], where voting takes place among the games that made it to the top hundred. Of course, Eva is also participating in it! ([i]Seriously, what kind of witchcraft is this?[/i])

notes.title: Update 1.0.135 - Controllers
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Complete overhaul of the game's input system
[*]Added support for almost every gamepad that exists and that doesn't
[*]Added more options for key binding
[*]You can now remap your controller buttons
[*]Added full Steam Input API integration (even more devices!)
[*]Eva will no longer guess what device you're using (now SHE KNOWS)
[/list]
Please note that due to a complete overhaul of the input system, this update resets your in-game keybindings.
Please also note that this update may not be stable and may cause bugs, crashes, or demon invocations.
